Name: Fairy Farmhouse
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Changes the farmhouse and greenhouse to be fairy themed and seasonal. 

With update 1.5, you can paint buildings! This mod automatically updates the farmhouse to match my mod, and if you want the greenhouse to be paintable, the mod contains an unused file for that!

Let me know if you have any mod suggestions or there are any mistakes!!

This is based on a art prompt from my server. If you'd like to join a great, small community of friends, click [url=https://discord.gg/qNQbEPQ]here
[/url]
You can also [url=https://ko-fi.com/dotsanddashes]support[/url] and [url=https://ko-fi.com/dotsanddashes/commissions]commission[/url] me!!
